verdict.rationale:
Semgrep supports writing custom rules (docs-4,5,21) that are automatically executed on repository events like pushes and pull/merge requests via CI integration (docs-25,28) or pre-commit hooks (docs-16), and matched findings can automatically trigger actions such as alerts, notifications, or ticket creation (docs-22,30). Community evidence corroborates real-world custom rule authoring (semgrep-comm-1).

missing for 10: independent verification that the alert/ticket triggering actually fires reliably in production, and richer documentation of webhook/automation-specific event triggers beyond standard CI hooks.
